summary: Replace local resource pending triggers with indexed idempotent writes.

replay.detail: Resource observation and canonical graph replay semantics do not change. The existing pending queue is flushed at open; this change does not retry previously invalid replica records.

schema.detail: A new local trigger-version marker replaces four persisted resource pending triggers in one opening transaction. Each trigger checks the subject primary key before insertion. The resource observation version remains 2, so existing stores do not rebuild all resource observations solely for this trigger change.

rules.detail: Claim validation, authority, signatures, nonce, checkpoint and replica admission rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Old binaries ignore the extra local marker and use the new trigger SQL, which uses ordinary SQLite SELECT and NOT EXISTS. An old binary reopening the store does not replace those triggers because its definitions use IF NOT EXISTS. A future upgrade checks the marker again. Downgrade behavior has not been executed.

downtime.detail: The first open after upgrade acquires a writer transaction for four DROP/CREATE trigger pairs and metadata, then performs the usual pending flush. The one-time DDL and flush cost are unmeasured; no full resource-observation rebuild is requested by this marker.

manual.detail: No manual migration or configuration change is required for trigger installation. Previously invalid records are not reset or repaired.

recovery.detail: A failed opening transaction rolls back trigger replacement and marker together. Exact-ID recovery of the two reported internal invalid records needs a separately reviewed bounded envelope retry path; this change provides no repair command or automatic retry.
